The endpoint correspondence is mathematically faithful in both directions. Submodule ℤ V describes arbitrary additive subgroups. Fin(l.toNat+1) is the complete integer interval under H002; T001 explicitly supplies both directions of that identification. The generator formulas include both endpoints and all out-of-range divided-power cases. R is a concrete rational subring, with its fraction description assigned to T006; excluded divisibility also excludes zero denominators. MR is the actual tensor R⊗ℤ M, and T006 proves the specified iota injective with image L before the image model is used. J is exactly the preimage of L under c↦c eᵢ. T012 gives the actual rational tensor multiplication, injectivity and image; T013–T016 derive rank one and a principal coefficient module rather than assume them. T017 specifies canonical tensor maps and intertwining for every integral endomorphism; T018's surjection and kernel identify Red with MR/pMR. LiftOf forces the unique restriction to M, and the conclusion includes existence, so its universal quantification over compatible lifts is not vacuous. Nontrivial and SimpleTriple express exactly the source's nonzero space and all-subspace dichotomy. Pinned Mathlib definitions confirm right-factor-first endomorphism multiplication, scalar-first baseChange, genuine basis coordinates, and the characteristic-p ZMod algebra action. All conversions are planned proof obligations, not extra hypotheses; their bodies are not certified by this review.
